issues.description: The problem statement's UML and task text specify Animal.messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (UML shows '+' visibility and the task asks to define messageOnFeed() as abstract), but the solution implementation declares it as protected abstract. This visibility difference is a structural mismatch that can confuse students about the intended visibility of the abstract method and may lead to test/implementation mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method signature in Animal explicitly public to match the UML and task description: declare 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' in Animal.java. Update any references if necessary (subclasses can still override it). This ensures the specification, template/solution, and students' expectations align.
